xiaoyaoclaw-task-progress-tracker 1.0.0

- Initial release of a lightweight, file-based task and project progress tracker for OpenClaw workspaces.
- Manages tasks/ and projects/ directories; each item uses a PROGRESS.md card for status, progress log, and document indexing.
- Covers full lifecycle: create (立项), update progress (进度), index documents, review, and complete tasks and projects.
- Triggered by natural language for setting up, updating, indexing docs, reviewing, and completing tasks/projects.
- Integrates with workspace initializer and memory distill skills as part of a complementary toolset.
- No CLI, no external service dependencies; operates through plain files only.
